title: Laminar 2.0: Serverless Stream Processing with Enhanced Code Search and Recommendations
problem: Serverless stream processing workflows require efficient mechanisms to discover similar code implementations and recommend processing elements through both structural and semantic matching, including handling incomplete code fragments.
motivation: Improved code search and recommendation capabilities accelerate workflow development and enable better reuse of components in serverless stream processing systems.
method: Laminar 2.0 enhances the dispel4py framework with improved dependency management and client-server architecture. It introduces structural code-to-code search using simplified parse syntax trees (SPTs) to identify similar Processing Elements, and semantic search through deep learning models with optimized text-to-code preprocessing.
key_novelty: Using simplified parse syntax trees (SPTs) for semantic code-to-code search that matches similar Processing Elements and workflows even from incomplete code.
contributions: Enhanced serverless framework with improved dependency management and client-server functionality
Structural code-to-code search using simplified parse syntax trees
Optimized text-to-code search with improved preprocessing
Deep learning models for semantic code recommendation

metrics.other: performance improvements over Laminar 1.0 (specific metrics not provided)
